meta.title: Birdy — Identify birds and keep a field journal
meta.description: Identify 839 European bird species by photo, camera or song. Save sightings in a private field journal, explore the bird guide and use Birdy offline. Available for Android; coming to iPhone.

hero.eyebrow: Your field guide, wherever you go
hero.headline: Know the bird.
hero.sub: Identify birds by sight or song. Explore 839 European species and save every find in your own private field journal.

loop.headline: From first glance to *field note.*
loop.sub: A simple way to turn the birds you meet into a journal worth keeping.

cards.title: Point or tap record
cards.body: Open the camera and aim, or tap to record a song. Birdy checks a few times a second.

cards.title: Match
cards.body: When Birdy is sure enough, you get a match.

cards.title: Save
cards.body: Confirm the match and keep the sighting in your journal. Each new species earns a stamp.

cards.title: Browse
cards.body: Look back whenever you like, or search all 839 European species.

glimpse.headline: Made for the *moment* outside.
glimpse.sub: A closer look at the app you take into the field.

listen.eyebrow: OR USE THE MIC · ON YOUR PHONE
listen.headline: Name it by *ear.*
listen.sub: Hold the button and let the bird sing. Birdy listens and names it.
listen.body: Record a short birdsong and Birdy suggests a match. The audio model runs on your phone, so nothing needs to be uploaded.
listen.caption: field recording, on-device

inside.headline: The whole field guide, *in your pocket.*
inside.sub: Search, learn, save and revisit — even without a signal.

coverage.headline: Where Birdy *works*
coverage.sub: Built around Europe's birds, from familiar garden visitors to rare encounters.
coverage.caption: 839 species across Europe.
coverage.fallbackAlt: Map of Europe filled in copper, marking where Birdy works today

premium.headline: *Free* first.
premium.sub: Premium adds a few extras if you want to go deeper.
premium.body: The core app is free, and always will be. Premium adds PDF export, seasonal stats and a handful of extra stamps — nice to have, never needed.

privacy.eyebrow: PRIVACY · NO PHOTOS LEAVE YOUR PHONE
privacy.headline: Fully *offline.*
privacy.sub: the AI lives in your phone
privacy.body: No cloud, no tracking, no accounts — just you and the birds.

items.q: How is this different from Merlin?
items.a: Merlin is brilliant at identifying birds — use it, it's great. Birdy is about what happens after: keeping each find in a field journal that's yours, offline, with no account. Many birders use both.
Yes. The AI runs entirely on your phone — both for camera and audio. No data leaves the device.
No. Open the app, point the camera, you're scanning. Your journal lives on the phone.
On your device. Birdy never uploads photos to a server. There is no server.
Good enough to learn from, honest when it's unsure. Every match shows a confidence level, and you always confirm before it's saved.
839 European birds — every species in the EBBA2 atlas plus close relatives, with descriptions, photos and range information.
Birdy for iPhone is planned for release at the end of September 2026. Android is available today; the App Store link will appear here once the iPhone app is live.
Hold the mic button for 3 seconds. BirdNET-Lite runs on-device, same offline guarantee.
Email albin@abrahamssons.se — I read every one.

finalCta.headline: Take Birdy *into the field.*
finalCta.sub: On Android now. Coming to iPhone.

footer.socialNote: Birdy is landing on social media — links coming soon.
